cards.title: Look up at noon
cards.idea: On a clear afternoon the sky overhead glows blue, but the sun itself looks white-yellow. The same sunlight is doing both.

interaction.prompt: Tap the patch of sky far from the sun

cards.reveal: That patch is blue even though no blue lamp is up there. The blue must come from sunlight bouncing off the air itself.

cards.title: Sunlight is a mix
cards.idea: White sunlight is really all colours packed together. A raindrop or prism can spread them into a rainbow band.

interaction.prompt: Tap the prism to split the sunlight beam

cards.reveal: Out comes red, orange, yellow, green, blue, violet. Each colour is light of a different wavelength: red long, blue and violet short.

cards.title: Air scatters short waves more
cards.idea: Tiny air molecules deflect light in all directions. This scattering is much stronger for short blue waves than for long red ones.

interaction.prompt: Slide from red end to blue end and watch the scattering

cards.reveal: Near red, light passes almost straight. Near blue, molecules fling it everywhere, so blue light fills the whole sky.

cards.title: Rayleigh scattering
cards.idea: Scattering of sunlight by air molecules, far stronger for shorter wavelengths, is called Rayleigh scattering. Scattered blue light reaches your eyes from every direction.

interaction.prompt: Tap to name why the sky looks blue

cards.reveal: Blue is scattered most, so it comes at you from all over the sky. That is why the daytime sky looks blue.

cards.title: Why sunsets go red
cards.idea: At sunset light travels through much more air. So much blue is scattered away that mostly red and orange survive the long path to you.

interaction.prompt: Drag the sun down to the horizon

cards.reveal: The longer path strips out blue, leaving red-orange light. Same scattering rule, different geometry, gives a red sunset.

workbook.prompt: Why does the daytime sky look blue?
options: Blue light is scattered by air more than red light
The sky is made of blue gas
The sun gives out only blue light
The ocean colours the sky blue
workbook.answer: Blue light is scattered by air more than red light

workbook.prompt: The scattering of sunlight by air molecules, stronger for shorter wavelengths, is called ________ scattering.
White sunlight is actually made of
options: all the colours of the rainbow
workbook.answer: all the colours of the rainbow

boss.prompt: At sunset the sky near the horizon turns red because
options: the sun changes colour in the evening
light travels a longer path through air, so most blue is scattered away
clouds add red dye to the light
red light is scattered more than blue at night
boss.answer: light travels a longer path through air, so most blue is scattered away

boss.prompt: Compared with red light, blue light has a ________ wavelength.
An astronaut in space sees the sky as black rather than blue mainly because
options: there is no sun in space
there is almost no air to scatter sunlight
space is too cold for blue light
all light stops in a vacuum
boss.answer: there is almost no air to scatter sunlight
